issue_context.title: Missing null checking
issue_context.body:
Hi, it seems that msg could be NULL, dereferencing in Line 104.

https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/af16097febcd4fa31cd5fcd05ad09cf8b53659ea/crypto/cmp/cmp_util.c#L103-L104

Other places with NULL check:

https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/af16097febcd4fa31cd5fcd05ad09cf8b53659ea/crypto/cmp/cmp_util.c#L49-L54

https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/af16097febcd4fa31cd5fcd05ad09cf8b53659ea/crypto/cmp/cmp_util.c#L89-L91

review_comments: This seems to change the existing logic. If I'm reading the code correctly then previously on exit from this function `msg` pointed to the character after `:`, or (if that is a space) the character after that. After your change it points to the `:` character, or (if the character after that is a space) it will point to the space character. That doesn't seem quite right.
Yeah you're right, I need a msg++ to increase the address
strchr() can evaluate to NULL, so `strchr() + 1` could add to a NULL pointer, which is UB?
